OpenLabel.description: The OpenLABEL root JSON object. This profile fully validates the scenario tagging sections (metadata, ontologies, tags); tags themselves carry no spatiotemporal or geometric constructs (spec 8.1). The labelling sections are accepted as unvalidated passthrough because spec 8.1.1 allows a labelling instance to be used as the raw data for tagging, so a conformant file may legitimately carry both.

TagEntry.description: A single tag in an ASAM OpenLABEL file. References a tag type from an ontology and optionally includes tag_data with values.

ontology_uid.description: UID of the ontology (from the ontologies section) where this tag type is defined. Required per the normative property table for the tag class (spec 8, Table 26: ontology_uid, Required = true). ASAM's own JSON Schema lists only "type" in "required", contradicting that table; this profile follows the normative text. All spec examples and all conformant files we have seen include ontology_uid, and keeping it required also avoids a LinkML simple-dict shorthand ASAM forbids.

UncheckedSection.description:
An OpenLABEL section that this profile accepts but deliberately does not validate. Used for the sections outside the tagging scope: they are accepted so that tagging data embedded in a labelling file validates (spec 8.1.1), but their contents are not checked here.
Modelled as an OPEN OBJECT -- `{"type": "object", "additionalProperties": true}` -- not as an unconstrained JSON value. ASAM types every one of these sections as an object, so accepting a scalar (`true`, `null`, `""`) would make this profile accept documents ASAM rejects, breaking the refinement relation. `extra_slots.allowed` keeps the object open without widening its type; `class_uri: linkml:Any` would emit the 5-type union `["null","boolean","object","number","string"]` and is therefore unsound here. See REFINEMENT_PROOF.md.
A reference to this definition is the marker that distinguishes "accepted" from "validated": a consumer that reports a document valid should also report which of its sections resolved to UncheckedSection, so that "valid" is never read as "fully checked".
UncheckedSection.title: UncheckedSection

UncheckedUidEntry.description: A passthrough entry in a UID-keyed OpenLABEL section (objects, contexts, actions, events, relations, resources). The VALUE is deliberately not validated here, but the KEY is: ASAM constrains these dict keys to a numeric UID or a UUID and closes the object, so accepting an arbitrary key would make this profile accept documents ASAM rejects.

uid.description: Numeric UID or UUID. Constrains the dict keys of the enclosing section, rendered as JSON Schema propertyNames.
